==Usage==
Place the following code on the page and replace the "EPISODE TITLE" with the appropriate episode name.
<nowiki>{{</nowiki>TheMandalorian|''EPISODE TITLE''}}

==Example(s)==
<code><nowiki>{{TheMandalorian|Chapter 1: The Mandalorian}}</nowiki></code>

Results in: {{TheMandalorian|Chapter 1: The Mandalorian}}
